description: Today, former Cecil County Executive Alan McCarthy announced his endorsement of Governor Wes Moore as he seeks reelection in 2026. “I made a promise to every single person of this state that we would continue to deliver real results for them no matter where they live or who they voted for, and we are going […]
title: Former Cecil County Executive Alan McCarthy Joins Republican Leaders Across Maryland In Endorsing Governor Wes Moore For Reelection - Wes Moore for Maryland
